stick_01: Side to side! Get low in your hockey stance, knees bent, hands out in front, puck centered. Here we go, slide it across your body. Left, right, left, right! Small, fast touches. Keep that head up. There you go, find the rhythm, nice and quick. Good, you're rolling now. Stay light on the blade, keep it smooth. Halfway there, stay quick! Looking good, keep those touches tight. Let's finish strong, count them down with me. Five, four, three, two, one. And done! Soft hands, quick hands. Nice work!
stick_02: Front to back! Get in your stance with the puck on your blade. Here we go, push it straight out in front. Reach! Now pull it smooth back to your toes. Push, pull, push, pull. There you go, find that steady rhythm. Soft hands the whole time, don't muscle it. Keep it rolling, nice and easy. You're halfway, stay smooth! Looking good, stay in the flow. Bring it home, last five. Four, three, two, one. And done! That's the flow. Great job!
stick_03: The L shape! Get set with the puck in front of you. Push it straight out, drag it back, then push it out wide to the side. Boom, that's an L! Forward, back, wide. There you go, trace that shape clean. Keep going, stay in control. Nice lines, own every inch. Halfway, looking good. Last three, two, one. Now switch! Push the L out to the other side this time. Forward, back, wide the other way. There you go, same clean shape. Keep it clean, you got it. Stay controlled, almost there. Last three, two, one. And done! Both sides, nailed it!
stick_04: Wide extensions! Get in a wide stance, puck centered. Reach it out as far as you can on your forehand side. Stretch! Now pull it all the way across to a big backhand reach. Forehand wide, backhand wide. There you go, lean into each one, stay balanced. Keep going, get wider each time. Big reaches, stay strong. Halfway there! The bigger the reach, the tougher you are to stop. Looking good, stretch it out. Last three, two, one. And done! Great stretch!
stick_05: Narrow to wide! Get set with the puck in tight. Three tiny touches, tick, tick, tick, then explode it out wide! Tiny, tiny, tiny, wide! Now back to tight and explode wide the other way. There you go, quick hands then push. Keep that pattern going. Stay tight, then explode, nice. Halfway, changing speed is what beats defenders! Looking good, keep the contrast sharp. Fast in tight, big push out. Last three, two, one. And done! Fast in tight, explode wide. Love it!
stick_06: Figure eight! Set up two cones about a stick length apart. Start guiding the puck around them in a smooth figure eight. Keep it flowing, no stops. There you go, feel the puck on your blade. Good, pick up the speed a little. Nice and smooth, stay with it. Halfway there, stay smooth! Count it down, three, two, one. Now reverse it! Run the eight the other way. Same smooth flow. There you go, keep it buttery. Keep it going. Looking good, flowing nice. Last three, two, one. And done! Both directions, buttery!
stick_07: The triangle! Picture a big triangle on the floor around your feet. Move the puck from point to point to point. Trace it clean, go slow first. There you go, controlled touches. Good, now pick up the pace. Slow is smooth and smooth is fast! Looking good, keep it clean. Halfway, keep those touches controlled. Three, two, one. Now reverse direction! Trace the triangle the other way. Point to point to point. There you go, stay sharp. Keep it clean. Nice, almost there. Last three, two, one. And done! Sharp work!
stick_08: The diamond matrix! Set up four cones in a diamond shape. Weave the puck around each point. Top, side, bottom, side. Keep your blade tight to the cones. Here's the key, glance up between each point instead of staring down. There you go, eyes up, hands working. Good, keep weaving! Halfway there, eyes up! Three, two, one. Now reverse your path! Weave it the other way around the diamond. Eyes up, stay tight. There you go, tight to the cones. Keep going. Looking good, hands and eyes together. Last three, two, one. And done! Hands and eyes working together!
stick_09: Z pattern! Start at one end with the puck. Push it forward and left on a diagonal, then cut forward and right. Keep that zig-zag going, move your feet with the puck. There you go, quick hands, quick feet. Sharp cuts! Halfway down the floor, stay sharp! Three, two, one. Now zig-zag your way back the other direction! Same sharp cuts. There you go, feet moving with the puck. Keep it going. Looking good, stay sharp. Last three, two, one. And done! Ripped it both ways!
stick_10: The square box! Get set with the puck in front. Trace a box, push it forward, slide it wide, pull it back, bring it across. Hit every corner with clean lines. There you go, one box after another. Keep tracing. Crisp corners, stay clean. Halfway, stay crisp on those corners! Three, two, one. Now reverse it! Trace the box the other direction. Front, side, back, side the other way. There you go, clean lines. Keep it going. Looking good, own every angle. Last three, two, one. And done! Owned every angle!
stick_11: Top hand only! Take your bottom hand right off the stick. Now control the puck with just your top hand. Small, tight, smooth moves. This one is tough, but it builds serious wrist and forearm strength. There you go, feel that forearm working. Keep it controlled. Stay smooth, you're strong. Halfway there, stay smooth! Looking good, control it. Bring it home, last five. Four, three, two, one. And done! Put that bottom hand back on and shake out the arm. Strong work!
stick_12: Bottom hand only! Take your top hand off the stick. Now your bottom hand runs the show. Steer the puck with small, gentle moves. Soft, light grip on the shaft, don't squeeze too hard. There you go, this hand does the detail work. Keep guiding it, stay light. Soft touch, nice and easy. Halfway, soft touch! Looking good, stay light. Last five, four, three, two, one. And done! Total control. You got it!
stick_13: Toe drag and rescue! Get set with the puck centered. Push it out wide to one side, let it drift, then hook it back with the toe of your blade. Roll the blade over, reel it in tight. Push wide, toe hook, rescue. There you go, smooth on that hook. Keep going on this side. Halfway, stay smooth on that hook! Three, two, one. Now switch to the other side! Push wide, toe hook, rescue, the other way. There you go, reel it in tight. Keep it controlled. Looking good, slick hands. Last three, two, one. And done! Both sides, slick!
stick_14: Heel to toe flips! Start the puck at the heel of your blade. Roll it smooth out toward the toe, and when it gets there, give it a little pop to lift it off the floor. Start with tiny pops. There you go, keep rolling and popping. Halfway, try for a little more lift! Looking good, clean pops. Last five, four, three, two, one. And done! Smooth roll, clean flip. Show off those hands!
stick_15: Flip over objects! Lay a stick flat on the floor as a barrier, puck on one side. Gently chip the puck over it, a soft lift, not a slap. Catch it soft on the other side and settle it. Chip and catch, back and forth. There you go, light hands. Keep it going. Soft lifts, nice and easy. Halfway there, stay soft! Looking good, clean over the top. Last three, two, one. And done! Clean lifts. Made it look easy!
stick_16: Eyes up! Get in your stance and start stickhandling. Now pick a target on the wall, or a parent, and lock your eyes on it. Keep stickhandling with your eyes forward. Feel the puck, trust your hands, don't peek! There you go, this is how the pros play. Good, hold that head up. Eyes forward, trust those hands. Halfway there, eyes stay up! Looking good, don't drop that head. Bring it home, last five. Four, three, two, one. And done! Head up the whole way. That's pro level!
stick_17: The wall bounce! Stand near a wall with the ball on your blade. Pass it into the wall, and when it comes back, catch it soft. Cushion that rebound, don't slap at it. Pass, cushion, pass, cushion. There you go, find your rhythm. Keep it going. Soft catches, nice and smooth. Halfway there, stay soft on the catch! Looking good, quick and clean. Last five, four, three, two, one. And done! Quick, clean, controlled. Nice touch!
stick_18: Cone weave course! Line up five cones in a straight row. Weave the puck through them, forehand, backhand, forehand, backhand. Start slow, keep it tight and clean. Reach the end, that's one pass. Now weave back the other way. There you go, pass after pass. Keep going. Tight to the cones, stay clean. Halfway through your passes, pick up the speed! Looking good, quick and clean now. Don't knock any cones. Stay smooth, almost there. Last pass now, fast and clean, rip through! And done! Weaved it clean both ways. Great job!
stick_19: Chaos dribbling! Scatter about ten random things on the floor, shoes, bottles, cones, whatever you've got. Now weave through them, no set path, no plan. Read the open space and react! Change direction whenever you want, that's real game action. There you go, head up, puck on a string. Keep moving, find new gaps! Nice, keep reacting. Halfway there, keep reacting! Looking good, stay creative. Almost done, stay creative. Five, four, three, two, one. And done! Total control in the chaos. Let's go!
shoot_01: Moving warm-up! Grab a puck and start about fifteen feet from the net. Start moving your feet toward the net, stickhandling as you go. Rule number one, your feet never stop! Pick a corner and shoot while you're still moving. That's one. There you go, grab another, new angle. Come in from a new angle, feet moving, shoot again. Keep going, a new angle each time. Nice, stay in motion. You're halfway, stay in motion! Looking good, feet never stop. A couple more from fresh angles. Last shot now, feet moving, head up, shoot! And done! Warmed up and moving. Let's go!
shoot_02: Change the angle! Put a cone between you and the net, that cone is a defender. Carry the puck toward it with your feet moving. Pull it around to one side, and the second it clears, shoot! That's one. There you go, take it the other side now. Now come again and take it around the other side. Forehand side, backhand side, keep alternating. Nice, quick release each time. Halfway there, quick release each time! Looking good, clear the cone and rip it. A few more. Last one, change the angle and fire! And done! Faster release, more goals. Nice!
shoot_03: Random target! Make four target areas on the net. Grab a puck and start moving toward it, head up. Now, find the target and shoot it! There's one. There you go, reset and go again. Next target, see it and fire! Don't stop your feet, don't pause to aim, just read it and rip it. Nice, a new target each time. Keep going. Trust your eyes, stay moving. Halfway, five down! Trust your eyes. Looking good, see it and hit it. A few more, see it, hit it. Last target now, fire! And done! Ten targets, read and reacted. Let's go!
shoot_04: Under two seconds! Start in your ready position, stick on the ice. Here comes a pass, catch it clean, look up, and fire! Two seconds max from catch to release. That's one. There you go, new spot, another pass. Move to a new spot, catch and fire. Don't overhandle it. Nice, fast off the blade. Keep going, fast off the blade each time. Halfway there, speed it up! Looking good, catch and let it fly. A few more, catch, find the opening, let it fly. Last one, quick as you can! And done! Speed beats the goalie every time. Great work!
shoot_05: Ten different goals! Grab your pucks. The challenge, score ten goals, and every one has to be different. Move before you shoot. Score your first one. Now change something, new angle, new release, forehand, backhand, high, low. That's two. There you go, make each one different. Keep going! Great goal scorers have a full bag of moves. Nice, stay creative. Halfway, five different goals down! If you repeat yourself it doesn't count. Looking good, mix it up. A few more, stay creative. Last one, make it your best! And done! Ten unique goals. You're dangerous everywhere!
shoot_06: Backhand basics! Stand about ten feet from the net, puck on your backhand. Cup it with your blade, hands a little away from your body. Shift your weight toward the net and sweep right through, finishing with your blade pointing at your target. That's one. There you go, load it up and sweep again. Cup, sweep, finish. Keep going, clean sweeps. Nice, feel that follow-through. Halfway there, feel that follow-through! Looking good, clean sweeps. A few more. Last one, cup it, sweep it, score! And done! Backhand's looking clean. Nice!
shoot_07: Backhand accuracy! Get in close, puck on your backhand. Here's the secret, look at your target before you shoot. Eyes first, puck second! Pick a corner, lock your eyes on it, then sweep it home. That's one corner. There you go, pick a different corner. Eyes on it first, then shoot. Work your way around all four corners. Nice, eyes lead the way. Halfway there, eyes lead every time! If you miss, make sure your eyes led the way. Looking good, corner by corner. A couple more corners. Last one, eyes first, sweep it home! And done! Own that backhand!
shoot_08: Moving backhand! Start about fifteen feet out and move toward the net. Keep your feet moving! Slide the puck to your backhand, hands away from your body, and shoot in stride. Don't stop your feet! That's one. There you go, new angle, feet moving. Reset, move the puck to your backhand, shoot. Straight on, left side, right side. Nice, feet never stop. Halfway there, feet never stop! Looking good, shoot in stride. A few more from fresh angles. Last one, moving backhand, fire! And done! Backhand on the move. Let's go!
shoot_09: Forehand to backhand! Come in with the puck on your forehand, chest facing the net to sell the fake. Now drag it across your body to your backhand in one smooth motion, and the moment it lands, shoot! No extra stickhandle. That's one. There you go, fake forehand, pull across. Reset and go again, fire backhand. Try it straight on, then from an angle. Nice, sell that fake. Halfway there, sell that fake! Looking good, no hesitation. A few more, no hesitation. Last one, pull across and rip it! And done! Deadly move. Nice!
shoot_10: Backhand only! Your mission, score ten goals, and every finish has to be a backhand. Start with the puck on either side and move toward the net. Create space however you want, then move it to your backhand and finish. That's one. If you score on the forehand by mistake, it doesn't count! There you go, reset, different setup. Keep going, backhand finishes only. Nice, try new angles. Halfway, five backhand goals down! Try new angles. Looking good, make it automatic. A few more. Last one, make that backhand automatic! And done! Ten on the backhand. Money!
shoot_11: Quick hands! Get in close, just a few feet from the net, puck tight to your body. Two or three quick, compact stickhandles, then push the puck just outside your feet and shoot right away. No big wind-up! That's one. There you go, other side now. Reset on the other side and do it again, quick hands, shoot. Keep alternating sides. Nice, stay compact and fast. Halfway there, stay compact and fast! Looking good, quick hands, quick shot. A few more. Last one, quick hands, quick shot! And done! Fast hands in tight beat the goalie. Let's go!
shoot_12: Catch and release! Set up near the net, stick on the ice and ready. Here comes a pass, catch it soft, then fire! No extra stickhandles, one touch to catch, one to shoot. That's one. There you go, change where the pass comes from. Left, right, behind, catch and release again. Keep going, quick off the blade. Nice, one touch and shoot. Halfway there, one touch and shoot! Looking good, quick off the blade. A few more from new angles. Last one, catch, release, score! And done! Speed in close wins games. Nice!
shoot_13: Pull across! Start close to the net, puck on one side. Sell a fake shot to move the goalie, then pull the puck quick across your body, hands away from your feet, and shoot the moment it reaches the new side. That's one. There you go, other direction now. Now set up and pull it the other direction. Keep alternating, sell, pull, shoot. Nice, no waiting on that release. Halfway there, no waiting on that release! Looking good, move it across. A few more. Last one, pull across and finish! And done! Move it across, bury it. Great work!
shoot_14: Forehand backhand finish! Move toward the net with the puck in front of you, head up. Don't decide early! At the very last second, read the open spot and pick forehand or backhand, then finish quick. That's one. There you go, read it late, other side now. Reset and go again, finish the other side this time. Mix it up, don't just pick your favorite. Nice, decide late every time. Halfway there, decide late every time! Looking good, read and react. A few more. Last one, read it and finish! And done! Dangerous on both sides. Let's go!
shoot_15: Rebound finish! Start about eight feet out. Take a low shot to create a rebound, and don't watch it, get to the net right away! Find the loose puck, get your stick on it, and finish with whatever side is open. That's one. There you go, shoot low again, crash. Reset, bury the rebound. Keep going, forehand or backhand, whatever works. Nice, crash that net. Halfway there, crash that net! Looking good, find it and finish. A few more. Last one, shoot, crash, finish! And done! Great goal scorers love rebounds. Money!
shoot_16: Carry, pass, shoot! Start away from the net, feet moving with the puck. Pass it to a wall, partner, or rebounder, then move right after you pass! Skate to open space, get your stick down, take the return, and shoot right away. That's one full play. There you go, new angle, run it again. Carry, pass, move, receive, shoot. Keep the play flowing. Nice, move after every pass. Halfway there, move after every pass! Looking good, keep it flowing. A few more. Last one, carry, pass, move, shoot! And done! Kept it flowing. Nice work!
shoot_17: Bad puck challenge! Get ready, because these passes are going to be ugly. Have someone send you bad pucks, bouncing, rolling, in your feet, behind you. Your job, find it, fix it, fire it! That's one. There you go, a different bad puck now. Handle it, control it fast and shoot. Don't try to make it pretty! Nice, control the chaos. Keep going. Looking good, find it and fire. Halfway there, control the chaos! Stay quick, a few more ugly ones. Last one, find it, fix it, fire! And done! That's how you score in real games. Let's go!
shoot_18: Angle attack! Put a cone in front of the net like a defender. Carry the puck straight at it, and wait until you get close before you move, don't bail early! Shift the puck and your body to one side, open a new lane, and fire. That's one. There you go, escape the other side now. Reset and attack again. Keep alternating, attack, escape, shoot. Nice, wait for it, then explode. Halfway there, wait for it, then explode! Looking good, attack and rip it. A few more. Last one, attack and rip it! And done! Attacked it and finished. Nice!
shoot_19: Quick release challenge! Start with no puck on your blade, stick ready. Here comes a pass, control it, find the net, shoot in under two seconds! It only counts if it's smooth and on target. That's one good release. There you go, another pass, catch and fire. Quick and clean. You need five in a row, so stay locked in. Miss the net and the streak starts over! That's three. Nice, two to go, stay smooth. One more, make it count. Last one, catch and fire! And done! Five clean releases in a row. Finish strong!
dry_01: Will's squares! Mark a square on the floor and number the corners one, two, three, four. Stay low! First pattern, both feet, hop one-two, one-three, one-four for twenty seconds. Light on your toes, head up. There you go, quick hops, stay light. Ten more seconds on this one. And switch! Now right foot only, same patterns, twenty seconds. Quick hops! Nice, stay balanced, keep it light. Halfway through your patterns. Now left foot only, twenty seconds, stay light! Looking good, quick and controlled. Now both feet, long patterns, one-two-three, one-four-two, twenty seconds. Push hard! There you go, sharp footwork. Last pattern, both feet long combos, twenty seconds, land light, head up! And done! Fast feet. Let's go!
dry_02: Skater jumps! Load up on one leg like a speed skater, knee bent. Explode sideways, land soft on the other leg, and hold it for a beat. Now back the other way, stick it! Landing soft matters more than jumping far. That's two. There you go, side to side, stick every landing. Keep going. Nice, quiet landings, stay controlled. You're rolling, halfway there, five each side! Stay controlled. Looking good, soft on every landing. Bring it home, last few. Three, two, and one. And done! Quiet landings, strong legs. Nice!
dry_03: Broad jumps! Stand tall, feet about hip-width apart. Swing your arms back, bend your knees, and explode forward! Land soft on both feet, knees bent, and hold that landing. That's one. There you go, reset, load up, jump again. Farther this time. Keep going, big arm swing, soft landing. Nice, hold each landing. Halfway there, four down! Reset between each one. Looking good, explode forward. A couple more, explode! Last jump, give it everything. And done! Soft landings, big power. Let's go!
dry_04: Box jumps! Face a sturdy low box or step. Bend your knees, swing your arms back, and jump up, land soft on top, both feet, knees bent. Land like a ninja! Stand up tall, then step back down, don't jump down. That's one. There you go, load up and go again. Quiet landing on top. Keep going. Nice, soft feet every time. Halfway there, five down, soft feet! Looking good, stand tall on top. A few more, stand tall each time. Last two, land quiet. And one more. And done! Ninja landings. Great work!
dry_05: Reverse lunges! Stand tall, hands on your hips. Step one foot straight back and drop down until both knees make an L shape. Chest up, front knee over your ankle. Drive through that front heel and stand up. Switch legs every rep. That's two. There you go, smooth and strong, alternating. Keep going. Nice, chest up, drive up strong. Halfway there, five each leg! Feel the power. Looking good, controlled tempo. A few more, drive up strong. Last two. And one. And done! Strong legs. Nice work!
dry_06: Single-leg RDL! Stand on one leg with a soft bend in that knee. Tip forward at your hips, reach toward the floor as your back leg lifts behind you, like a seesaw. Keep your back flat. Squeeze that standing leg and come back up tall. That's one. Stay on this leg for all your reps. There you go, slow and steady, control the wobble. Halfway on this side, four down! Nice, keep that back flat. A couple more. Last one on this leg. Now switch legs! Balance on the other side, same seesaw tip. Eight on this leg, slow and controlled. There you go, steady balance. Halfway, four to go! Looking good, control it. Last one. And done! Balance and control. Great job!
dry_07: Wall sit! Put your back flat against a wall and walk your feet out. Slide down until your knees make an L shape, like sitting in a chair. Back flat, weight in your heels. Hold it! Thirty seconds. Breathe steady. There you go, you're doing great, hold strong. Stay down, weight in those heels. Fifteen seconds, halfway there, when your legs burn you're getting stronger! Keep holding, you got this. Ten more. Almost there, stay down. Final five, four, three, two, one. And done! Stand up and shake it out. Strong legs win games!
dry_08: Sit-ups! Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Cross your arms over your chest. Curl up slow using your belly, not your neck, then lower back down with control. Breathe out on the way up. That's one. There you go, steady pace, belly does the work. Keep going. Nice, don't pull your neck. Halfway there, seven, eight! Stay controlled. Looking good, breathe it out. A few more. Last five, four, three, two, one. And done! Core's getting stronger. Nice work!
dry_09: Plank with shoulder taps! Get up on your hands and toes, arms straight, body in one straight line. Squeeze your belly so your hips don't sag. Now start tapping, right hand to left shoulder, put it back, left hand to right shoulder. Slow and steady. Thirty seconds! There you go, keep those hips still, don't rock. Nice, slow and steady taps. You're doing great, halfway there, fifteen seconds! Keep tapping across. Stay strong, hips quiet. Ten more. Stay strong, hips quiet. Final five, four, three, two, one. And done! Drop and shake it out. Rock solid!
dry_10: Stair sprints! Find a safe set of stairs, start at the bottom. On go, run up quick and light, pump your arms, eyes up! At the top, walk back down slow to recover. That's round one. Catch your breath, nice and easy on the way down. And go again, sprint up round two! Fast up, slow down. There you go, pump those arms. Round three, drive those arms! You're halfway, keep it up. Walk down and recover, breathe. Round four, quick feet up! Looking good, one round left. Last one, sprint to the top! And done! Fast up, slow down, five rounds. Let's move!
dry_11: Sprint starts! It's all about the explosive first step. Get in your ready position, one foot back, knees bent, leaning forward. On go, drive off that back leg, pump your arms, explode into your first few steps! That's one. Slow down safe, walk back, reset. And go again, burst out, start two! Powerful steps. There you go, reset and breathe. Start three, explode! Halfway done, reset and breathe. Nice, shake it out. Start four, drive hard! Looking good, one start left. Last one, make it your fastest! And done! Explosive starts, five done. Great work!
dry_12: Reaction start! Face your partner a few steps away while they hold a ball out. Stay in your ready position, eyes locked on that ball. When they drop it, explode and catch it before the second bounce! Don't guess, react! That's one. There you go, reset, eyes on the ball. Go, react and catch! Keep going. Nice, see it drop then go. Halfway there, five catches! Looking good, stay quick. A few more, stay quick. Last one, react and grab it! And done! Lightning reflexes. Let's go!
dry_13: Split squat hold! Step into a lunge, one foot forward, one foot back. Lower straight down until both knees make an L shape, and hold! Chest tall, weight balanced. Twenty seconds on this side. There you go, fight through the burn, stay down. Ten more seconds. Almost there. Five, four, three, two, one. Now switch legs! Other foot forward, drop down and hold. Twenty seconds this side. There you go, stay tall, stay down. Halfway, ten seconds. Hold strong. Five, four, three, two, one. And done! Both legs. Strong work!
dry_14: Calf raises! Stand tall, feet about hip-width apart, hand on a wall for balance. Push up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can, pause at the top, then lower down slow. That's one. There you go, up tall, pause, down slow. Keep the rhythm going. Nice, control the way down. Halfway there, ten done! Stay tall at the top. Looking good, high on those toes. Keep going, control the way down. Last five, four, three, two, one. And done! Rocket legs. Nice work!
dry_15: Dead bugs! Lie on your back, arms reaching up, knees bent over your hips. Press your low back flat into the floor and keep it there. Slowly lower your right arm overhead and your left leg toward the floor, then bring them back. Now the other side, left arm, right leg. That's two. There you go, slow and smooth, keep that back flat. Keep going, alternating sides. Nice, slow is the key here. Halfway there, five each side! Looking good, control every rep. A few more. Last two, and one. And done! Core power. Great job!
dry_16: McDavid's! The ultimate brain and feet drill. Get low in your hockey stance, feet moving fast, shuffling over a line. Stickhandle a ball or puck right in front of you, soft, quick touches. Now the hard part, eyes on your partner, call out every number they flash! Sixty seconds, go! There you go, feet moving, hands working, eyes reading. Keep it up! Stay low, quick touches. You're at thirty seconds, halfway, stay low! Don't slow down, call those numbers. Looking good, keep grinding. Twenty more seconds. Keep grinding! Final ten. Five, four, three, two, one. And done! Feet, hands, and eyes all at once. Beauty!
